therapeutic_hypothesis.proposed_mechanism: ALK kinase inhibition + VEGF pathway inhibition
therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: tumor cell proliferation inhibition + angiogenesis inhibition
therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: Advanced, ALK-positive, non-small cell lung cancer patients
therapeutic_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: Recommended Phase II dose determination and intracranial hemorrhagic events

results.effect_size: CNS ORR: 66.7% (Phase I), 60% (Phase II); Overall ORR: 83.3% (Phase I), 60% (Phase II)
subgroup_findings: Phase I showed better outcomes than Phase II
CNS PFS: 23.87 months (Phase I) vs 7.21 months (Phase II)
results.dose_information: Alectinib 600 mg twice daily PO + Bevacizumab 15 mg/kg IV every 21 days

context.investigator_commentary: Trial was terminated early with only 11 patients enrolled
